description:
Current stoa-smtp has one DKIM key for one domain. Multi-domain requires per-domain keys.

Schema:
  dkim_keys(domain FK references domains(domain), selector, private_key blob or secretx URI, created_at, PRIMARY KEY (domain))

Signing decision: sign outbound mail with key for envelope_from domain. If no key exists for that domain: configurable behavior — sign with default key, sign without domain alignment, or refuse to send. Default should be refuse (misconfigured domain is an operator error, not a silent degradation).

Key rotation: new selector + new key, publish new DNS record, keep old key for TTL window (typically 48h), then remove old. Admin API: generate new key, return public key for DNS TXT record, schedule old key removal.

Config migration: existing [delivery.dkim] single-key config maps to a dkim_keys row for the configured domain on first start. No breaking change.
title: design: per-domain DKIM keys
